rules.content: Before creating, moving, or writing files, run pwd and ls to confirm the current directory and find target folders. After any cd, verify the new current directory before mutating files.
Navigate one level at a time: use cd with a single folder name only. Do not pass multi-level paths, since tools may reject path arguments.

For path-restricted mv, destination must be a local name, not a path. To move into a subdirectory and rename: mv source existingDir; cd existingDir; mv originalRename newName. Do not use dir/newName. Verify with ls after each step.
If writing fails with 'No such file', create the file first with touch, then write.
After writing, verify contents with cat and wc (characters/lines/words). Cross-check tool outputs before concluding success.
Treat empty diff output cautiously: comparing an empty file and a non-empty file may still yield no lines. Inspect actual contents with cat/wc before concluding files match or differ.
